exact_prompt: Transparent six-view correction atlas exactly 6 columns x 3 rows, view order FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Row1 is the forest tree-root arch, row2 the forest shrine, row3 the abandoned woodland hut. Use current source+six contact for source identity/materials. Only flagged views are used. Row1 TREE-ROOT ARCH TOP and BOTTOM: look exactly down/up along vertical axis. The arch is a thin upright plane, so the projection is a narrow horizontal connecting root span with short foot/root thickness at its ends; upright U-shaped arch and tall trunks are occluded, do not lay a deep U silhouette flat or make a large rectangular plan. Row2 SHRINE TOP: direct overhead of the stone altar/cap and actual candle tops; the large round frontal medallion/back-slab is upright and must be edge-on/occluded, never show its entire circular face from above. Row3 HUT RIGHT and LEFT: strict side elevations perpendicular to the hut's long front-to-back roof ridge. Show the sloped roof planes running into depth with eaves, one side wall and its side window; no front gable triangle and no three-quarter front view. The ridge direction and roof orientation are fixed and coherent with source. Match forest timber/stone, ivy, candles and warm colors. Axis-aligned orthographic, no isometric or perspective, centered full object, transparent background, no labels/borders/neighbor parts.
